newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER FALLS, VOLUME FLAT.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER FALLS, VOLUME FLAT.

text.p: Turnover fell and traded volume was little changed at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Total turnover shrank to 527,512 denars from 2.472 million denars with 283 shares changing hands, down from 285 units at the previous session on Tuesday.
Gradski Targovski Centar AD sold 283 shares at 1,864 denars each on the first floor, unchanged from Tuesday's close and below par of 2,663 denars.

Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. Unlisted ones, mostly firms offered for privatisation, trade in a third floor session. The exchange trades twice a week. ($1=40.44 denars; 1DEM=26.63 denars) -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-981 4145
